text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) meant facing 
battle-hardened Umamusume. How would I 
hold my ground against them? While the 
onlookers focused on that question――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What I felt was the sheer pressure of my 
archrival. An absolute, crushing weight 
greater than that of a battle-hardened 
army.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I must see it for myself. The true nature 
of that strength—on this very battlefield!
